name: opencode-oceanus
description: OpenCode v2 plugin that registers the Oceanus agent orchestrator and its specialist agents

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts src/tui.tsx --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @opencode/plugin --external @opencode/schema --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.check:dist: bun run verify:dist:auto-update && bun run verify:dist:skills
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run check:dist
